en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a medieval cylindrical stone tower with a steep conical roof standing along a broad street or square. The tower has small rectangular windows and is flanked by multi‑story townhouses. Leafless trees line the street, mountains are faintly visible in the background, and several pedestrians, including a child in the foreground, walk or stand near the tower.
